attchmntText: The Motor & General Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30,2026
voiceSummary: The Motor and General Finance Limited submitted the published copy of the extract of its Statement of Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, under Ind-AS Rules. The results were published in The Financial Express and Jansata on November 14, 2026. This filing is made in terms of Regulation 47 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The company requests the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange to take the submission on record.

attchmntText: The Motor & General Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: The Motor and General Finance Limited Board approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated net profit for the six months ended September 30, 2026, was 293.98 lakhs. This includes a net exceptional gain of 15758.22 lakhs recognized for the year ended March 31, 2026, primarily from property sales. Revenue from operations stood at 372.06 lakhs for the six-month period. Basic earnings per share were 0.76. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the limited review. The trading window, closed since October 1, 2026, reopens on November 16, 2026. Related party transaction details for the half year are filed in XBRL mode.

attchmntText: The Motor & General Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: The Motor and General Finance Limited board approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 67.04 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of 205.57 lakhs in the same period last year. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 294.50 lakhs, versus a loss of 180.83 lakhs in the prior year. Revenue from operations stood at 186.03 lakhs for the quarter and 372.06 lakhs for the half year. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the results. The trading window, closed since October 1, 2026, reopens on November 16, 2026.
